text: "Self-host cutover (Recommended path, staged)" and "Pin FrankenPHP" — dply's first self-deploy runs as a container app on Cloudflare, verified on a preview URL before edge.dply.io's DNS is pointed at it, with the old VM kept as rollback and a production DB backup taken first. dply's own container image runs FrankenPHP (a server override for the self site only), not Swoole Octane or FPM.
